title: @eddacraft/nxrust:cache-report
description: Report the effective cache contract per inferred Rust target (read-only): inputs, outputs, the env allowlist pinned into the cache key, and the resolved target-dir (honours CARGO_TARGET_DIR).

project.description: Restrict the report to a single project by name.

json.description: Emit the report as structured JSON instead of the human-readable layout.
